per_line.source_text: Ordinary confirmed matches and verified, non-conflicting coffees are not manual admin tasks. Genuine identity conflicts or ambiguous duplicates go to the administrator; user-resolvable fuzzy matches must not. A genuinely new coffee that has not met source-backed or automated verification requirements remains **Pending** and may be logged privately, but its observations are not eligible for community evidence until verification. This follows Master Specification sections 9.1–10.4, 11, and 32; do not silently auto-approve unverified coffees merely because no duplicate was found.
